name: Chao trang
summary: Plain rice porridge on the breakfast street, with a fish braise beside it. The 18 May 2020 page says cháo trắng with cá kho. The 19 Jun 2019 roundup says cháo trắng with kho cá cơm. Both fish names stay.
origin: Named as a Huỳnh Thúc Kháng breakfast. The two pages do not use the same fish name.
howToEat: Order the porridge with the fish the counter is serving that morning. The pages do not say which fish wins. Check on arrival.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The 2020 page says the street is crowded from 06:00 to 08:00. The 2019 page prints 06:00–12:00.
seoTitle: Chao trang — porridge and fish on the breakfast street
seoDescription: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng serves cháo trắng with cá kho on the 2020 page and with kho cá cơm on the 2019 page. Both names stay. Check on arrival.
